notes.title: Patch note ver 1.01.29
notes.content:
Updated Contents
 - The English translations of some special snaps have been corrected.
 - The translation of some of the special snaps has been improved.
 - Added the ability to view achievements from the in-game menu.
 - Scanned and implemented English manuals and packages.
 - Achievements and special snaps that could not be obtained under certain conditions can now be obtained correctly.
 - Other minor bugs have been fixed.
Please continue to enjoy HEBEREKE Enjoy Edition.

notes.title: patch note ver 1.00.42
notes.content:
Update contents and note
 - Fixed a bug that caused the game to run faster in some environments.
 - Fixed a problem with cloud saving that was causing problems in some cases. Please log out and try again.
 - Screen edges can now be shown and hidden. This cuts off a few dots at the edge of the game screen. (Please use this function if you are concerned about screen turbulence at the edges.)
 - VSync ON/OFF has been added to the screen settings on the top page. 60 FPS is maintained whether VSync is ON or OFF. Basically, there should be no problem with ON.
 - If you experience tearing (screen distortion), please check if VSync is set to On in the screen settings on the top page.
 - Fixed a minor bug.

Please continue to enjoy 'HEBEREKE Enjoy Edition'.

notes.title: Patch note 1.00.34
notes.content:
ver 1.00.34.
 - Fixed a part where MyName and ranking records were not displayed on the ranking screen.
 - Screen settings have been added to the bottom of the top menu.
    - Window Mode : Full Screen Mode, Borderless Window Mode, Window Mode
    - Resolution : 1920x1080, 1280x720
 - VSync is now always On.

That is all. Please continue to enjoy.

notes.title: Patch note 1.0.015
notes.content:
ver 1.00.15.

 - ScreenFilter is added to Options. Bilinear interpolation of game screens can be turned ON/OFF. Due to the urgent response, specifications and layout may change in the future.

 - Fixed a bug that Japanese text remained when the language setting was English.
 - Fixed some spelling errors.

That's all. Please continue to enjoy the game.
